holdings.name: The Federal Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: CARE reaffirmed the bank's issuer and bond ratings at AA+ Stable on October 9, 2026.
The bank introduced the Verto Resident Savings Account on October 7, 2026.
Net profit for June 2026 reached ₹1,302 crore with revenue at ₹7,862 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: Federal Bank is the top holding at 3.06% of the portfolio. With a 1-year return of 54.68% and a modest 3-month return of 0.61%, its steady credit rating and liability franchise support the fund's 25.3% allocation to financials.

watch.text: Q2 FY27 standalone and consolidated earnings scheduled for board approval on October 16, 2026.

holdings.name: Multi Commodity Exchange Of India Ltd

what_changed.text: The company received a GST Show Cause Notice on September 29, 2026, proposing ₹54.08 crore in tax, ₹43.82 crore in interest, and a ₹5.41 crore penalty.
Senior management roles were reorganized on October 8, 2026, including appointments for Strategy, Strategic Corporates, and Precious and Base Metals.
June 2026 sales came in at ₹702 crore with operating profit of ₹494 crore and net profit of ₹413 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 2.70% weight, MCX was the fund's second-largest positive contributor over 3 months (+0.389% contribution on a 14.41% gain), offsetting weakness elsewhere in financials.

watch.text: Board review of unaudited Q2 FY2026 results scheduled for November 3, 2026.

holdings.name: Solar Industries India Ltd

what_changed.text: Solar Defence delivered a consignment of Nagastra kamikaze loitering munitions to the Indian Army.
A step-down unit was incorporated in Botswana with a 65% stake for USD 325,000 on September 29, 2026.

ICRA rated its ₹500 crore commercial paper [ICRA]A1+, while CRISIL placed ₹1,479.5 crore of bank facilities and ₹35 crore NCDs on rating watch developing following the proposed $1.35 billion Omnia transaction.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 2.09% weight, the stock gained 9.84% over 3 months despite a 1-month pullback of -9.88%, representing a key defense and materials bet for the fund.

watch.text: Execution and credit rating developments regarding the proposed $1.35 billion Omnia acquisition.

holdings.name: City Union Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: The bank opened a branch at Zoho Corporation on September 25, 2026, reaching 1,002 total branches.
The bank participated in an institutional CEO forum on September 28, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 2.02% weight, City Union Bank provided consistent positive performance (3.16% 1-month and 5.96% 3-month returns), bolstering regional banking exposure within the financial basket.

watch.text: Q2 and half-year financial results to be approved on October 28, 2026.

holdings.name: Persistent Systems Ltd

what_changed.text: The company secured a 94.04% stake in Nagarro SE under its takeover offer as of October 6, 2026.
ICRA assigned an AA+ rating watch negative for ₹5,000 crore proposed NCDs, while retaining the issuer rating at AA+.
Chief Delivery Officer Rajesh Gharpure resigned effective October 14, 2026, and a third facility was opened in Hyderabad.

holdings.why_it_matters: Carrying a 1.99% weight, Persistent contributed +0.333% over the past 3 months on a 16.75% gain, driving performance in the fund's 8.7% technology sector.

watch.text: Closing of the Nagarro takeover expected by Q1 CY27 and integration process.

holdings.name: Coforge Ltd

what_changed.text: Workforce at the Kraków AI engineering facility is expanding to exceed 660 personnel by 2027.
The company introduced CXNova for enterprise AI customer experience orchestration alongside an intent engineering framework.
HDFC Mutual Fund reduced its shareholding to 4.30% on October 6, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 1.98% weight, Coforge was the top single 3-month contributor (+0.509% on a 25.71% stock return), leading the technology sleeve's outperformance.

holdings.name: Marico Ltd

what_changed.text: The company acquired an additional 24.09% in Satiya Nutraceuticals for ₹1,012.03 crore, taking its stake to 84.09%.
Q2 FY27 quarterly business update flagged double-digit volume growth in India and double-digit consolidated revenue growth.

expected.text: Management signaled double-digit India volume growth and double-digit consolidated revenue growth in its Q2 FY27 update.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 1.92% weight, Marico has retreated -7.72% over 3 months, acting as a drag on consumer staples exposure despite positive volume indications.

watch.text: Approval of Q2 and half-year results by the board on November 2, 2026.

holdings.name: BSE Ltd

what_changed.text: Sales reached ₹1,566 crore and net profit rose to ₹873 crore for the June 2026 quarter.
The company scheduled an investor meeting with Blackrock in late September 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: At 1.92% of the fund, BSE was among the top 3-month detractors, shedding -11% and generating an estimated -0.211% negative contribution.

watch.text: Board meeting on November 4, 2026, to review Q2 and half-year unaudited results.

holdings.name: Ipca Laboratories Ltd

what_changed.text: June 2026 sales grew to ₹2,788 crore with operating margins expanding to 24% and net profit reaching ₹424 crore.
Management increased full-year guidance to 14-16% consolidated growth and 23% margin during its Q1 call.

expected.text: Management raised company guidance to 14-16% top-line growth and a 23% operating margin for the year.

seeing.text: June 2026 operating margin came in at 24%, slightly above the 23% full-year margin target.

holdings.why_it_matters: Representing 1.84% of the fund, Ipca provides an anchor in Healthcare (8.9% sector weight), delivering a 30.82% gain over 6 months despite a flat 3-month period (+3.14%).

watch.text: Sustained execution against the raised 14-16% growth target in Q2.

holdings.name: Radico Khaitan Ltd

what_changed.text: June 2026 quarterly net profit expanded to ₹230 crore on sales of ₹1,684 crore with operating margin rising to 21%.
The company expanded distribution of Rampur and Sangam whisky brands across duty-free stores at four UK airports.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 1.72% allocation, Radico Khaitan has surged 61.70% over 6 months and 12.07% over 3 months, offering strong earnings momentum within consumer staples.

watch.text: Board review of Q2/H1 FY26 results set for October 27, 2026.

portfolio.statement: Edelweiss Mid Cap Fund holds ₹19,230 crore in AUM with 97.1% in equities across mid-cap cyclicals and growth sectors, led by Financials (25.3%), Consumer Discretionary (19.1%), and Industrials (13.0%).
interp: The portfolio experienced a 3-month dip of -4.73% and 1-month dip of -4.94%, reflecting sharp pullbacks in healthcare and capital market holdings like Fortis Healthcare (-22.0%) and BSE (-11.0%).
Strong performance in Technology holdings Coforge (+25.71%) and Persistent Systems (+16.75%), along with MCX (+14.41%), served as primary 3-month positive contributors.
portfolio.line: Outperformance in IT and exchange platforms partially buffered broader mid-cap corrections across healthcare and lending names.

drivers.text: IT holdings rallied on AI expansion and M&A progress, with Coforge gaining 25.71% and Persistent climbing 16.75%.
Capital markets and exchange volume trends showed divergence, as MCX rose 14.41% while BSE declined 11.00%.
